quick_ratio.formula: (Cash and Due from Banks + Deposits with Banks + Federal Funds Sold and Securities Purchased under Resale Agreements + Securities Borrowed + Trading Assets) / (Accounts Payable and Other Liabilities + Short-term Borrowings + Trading Liabilities + Federal Funds Purchased and Securities Loaned or Sold under Repurchase Agreements)
